# uni shortlist

> A free search over every UK undergraduate course listed on UCAS, built for comparing entry requirements side by side across universities and keeping a shortlist. It serves a monthly snapshot of UCAS course data (about 30,000 course options for 2027 entry, plus 2026 and 2025), so figures can be a few weeks behind UCAS itself.

What a visitor can do on the site:

- Search by subject and by one or more universities, or leave either blank to search everything.
- Filter by qualification (Bachelor's, integrated Master's, foundation year, HND and others), full-time or part-time study, UK region, and a maximum entry requirement from BBB to A*A*A.
- Sort by university, course name or entry requirement. Entry requirements given as A-level grades and as UCAS tariff points are converted to one scale, so the two can be compared and ranked.
- Open a course to see its UCAS page link and Discover Uni figures, such as the spread of entrants' tariff points.
- Pick universities quickly from the 2027 Times and Sunday Times Good University Guide, the Guardian University Guide, or the UK universities in the QS World University Rankings.
- Star courses into a shortlist, save searches, share either as a link, and export results to CSV. The shortlist and saved searches stay in the visitor's browser; nothing about them is stored on the server.

Sources: course data from UCAS; student figures adapted from the Discover Uni dataset by HESA (https://www.hesa.ac.uk), licensed under CC BY 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). The site is independent and is not affiliated with UCAS.
